names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 25 noiembrie, «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Mercurie», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Μερκούριος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας», with the rank word left off.

The heading of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 24 ноября ст. ст., name page 1519, «Меркурий Кесарийский (Каппадокийский), военачальник, вмч.», with the rank and the grade left off the head. The parenthesis is the page's own. `.tmp/ru-foldnew.mjs` reports no folder holding this form; the bare «Меркурий» was refused, because four folders of this corpus would answer to it.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 24. новембар ст. ст., „Св. вел. мученик Меркурије.“ — «Св.» is “saint” and not a rank and «вел. мученик» is the `great-martyr` grade `types` already keeps, so both come off and the heading prints nothing else; the regiment, the rank of commander and Cappadocia are all in the body. Measured: no other folder in the corpus holds this string — `mercurius-of-smolensk`, who stands on the same menologion number, does not — so it joins no fold.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 ноября ст. ст. — «Вмч. Меркурия (III).»

attestations.note: The name link behind the line heads him «Меркурий Кесарийский (Каппадокийский), военачальник, вмч.» and its life page is the life of this folder's man: a soldier of Decius and Valerian, beheaded at Caesarea in Cappadocia, and afterwards sent by the Theotokos at the prayer of Basil the Great against Julian the Apostate. «вмч.» is великомученик, the `great-martyr` this folder carries and the only one of the corpus's four Mercuriuses that does. The Russian day is one menologion number before the 25 November the Greek and Romanian rows carry, which is a difference of one day and not the thirteen of a style conversion, so each church keeps its own day here. The life page gives no year for the beheading — it dates the two reigns and not the death — so this folder's `dates` are left as the Greek reading made them.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 25 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Mercurie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Μερκούριος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/1056/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: the great-martyr soldier of Decius's army, which is what the folder's `great-martyr` and `soldier` already say. A death interval is proposed from the page's own years where the folder had none. He is not the `mercurius-of-smolensk` of 24 November, nor `mercurius-the-faster`, both of which that day's listing keeps. The hymn taken is the page's Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), which names him and no other saint and carries both an ἦχος and a model; the Μεγαλυναριον beside it, which also names him, is neither a troparion nor a kontakion and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.12.2025 (24. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. вел. мученик Меркурије.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry. HE IS NOT `mercurius-of-smolensk`, the other Mercurius the corpus keeps on this same menologion number: this is the soldier of Decius beheaded in Cappadocia, whose folder is the bare «Mercurius», a `great-martyr` and `soldier`. `dates` WIDENED, which is this day's one field change: the book says «Пострада за веру овај прекрасни војник Христов између 251- 259. год.», between 251 and 259, where the folder held saint.gr's «between 253 and 259»; the interval is widened at the early end to hold both readings and neither is preferred, which is the practice the folder's own note already follows. No `related` row: Basil the Great and Eupsychius are already there, and the men this entry names — Decius, the envious accusers, the angel — are not folders of this corpus. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that he was a commander over the Armenian regiment called the Martenses in Decius's war against the barbarians; THE ANGEL WHO PUT A SWORD INTO HIS HANDS IN THE BATTLE and told him he would conquer, and the enemies cut down like grass with it; his promotion to first commander of the whole army after the victory; the envious men who denounced him as a Christian and his open confession of it before the emperor; the knives that cut him into strips and the fire that scorched him; the angel who healed him in prison; the sentence to be beheaded in Cappadocia; HIS BODY TURNING WHITE AS SNOW AFTER THE BEHEADING with a wonderful scent of incense coming out of it; and the many sick healed at his relics. Measured: no other folder holds «Меркурије».

hymns.text:
Degrab ne întâmpină pre noi...
Nevoințele muceniciei răbdându-le ca un ostaș nebiruit ai stătut înaintea împăratului celui nemuritor, Mare Mucenice Mercurie, unde împreună cu cetele pătimitorilor luând îndrăzneală, grăbește cu rugăciunile tale spre ajutorul celor ce cu credință cinstesc pomenirea ta.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mare Mucenic Mercurie (the page prints the podobie line «Degrab ne întâmpină pre noi...» above the text)

english.text: To the model melody: Come quickly to meet us. Having endured the contests of martyrdom as an unconquered soldier, you stood before the immortal King, great martyr Mercurius; and having boldness there with the ranks of the sufferers, hasten with your prayers to the help of those who faithfully honour your memory.

hymns.text: Οὐράνιον Ἄγγελον, χειραγωγὸν ἀσφαλῆ, πρὸς δόξαν ἀρίδηλον, ὡς τοῦ φωτὸς κοινωνός, Μερκούριε ἔσχηκας· ὅθεν τῷ ἀθανάτῳ, Βασιλεῖ πειθαρχήσας, ἤθλησας ὑπὲρ φύσιν, ὡς γενναῖος ὁπλίτης· διὸ τοὺς σοὶ προσιόντας, μάκαρ περίσωζε.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιος Μερκούριος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας». It names him and no other saint.

english.text: You had a heavenly Angel for a sure guide by the hand towards a glory plain to see, Mercurius, as a sharer of the light; and so, obeying the immortal King, you contended beyond nature, like a brave man-at-arms. Therefore, blessed one, keep safe those who come to you.

hymns.text: Мученик Твой, Господи, Меркурий/ во страдании своем венец прият нетленный от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имеяй бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложи,/ сокруши и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Того молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь великомученика Меркурия»

english.text: Thy martyr Mercurius, O Lord, received in his suffering an incorruptible crown from thee our God; for having thy strength he cast down the persecutors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Во бранех непобедимаго воина/ и в бедах непостыдна заступника,/ песньми Меркурия ублажим, славяще,/ празднующия бо память его весело// от бед избавляет и скорбей.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак великомученика Меркурия»

english.text: Let us bless Mercurius with hymns and glorify him, the soldier unconquered in battle and the defender who does not put us to shame in trouble; for he gladly delivers from troubles and from sorrows those who keep his memory.

death.note: Two books and two intervals, widened to hold both rather than choosing. saint.gr: «τον αποκεφάλισαν στην Καισαρεία της Καππαδοκίας, μεταξύ των ετών 253 και 259 μ.Χ.» — the page's own interval for the beheading and not a reign. Охридски пролог за 24. новембар ст. ст.: «Пострада за веру овај прекрасни војник Христов између 251- 259. год.» The later end agrees; the earlier end differs by two years and the wider reading is kept. Neither book gives a year of birth.
